rights.body: Accepted CC0 original Blender Studio continuous human, unchanged rest topology/binding.
rights.text: Repository canonical catalogue records and complete prepared briefs; retain existing catalogue/brief text notices.

coordinate_basis: 1Blender unit=1metre. Character1.8m at rest, facing-Y. AnatomicalLeft=+X. Floor z=0. Engine conversion[x,z,-y].
source_vs_authored: Full source briefs are stored separately in source-briefs.json and primary-owned prepared contexts. Durations, exact poses, joint poles, support coordinates and illustrative tolerances are authored, not source-verified coaching data.
joint_policy: Explicit knee flexion plane removes the antiparallel shortest-rotation ambiguity. Hands use articulated original fingers. No mesh/weight/rest-bone edits or new corrective. All displayed angles are segment geometry, not validated anatomical joint limits.

initial_body_support_unresolved.decision: Seated balance on the pelvic support surface, torso inclined about45degrees above the floor and both feet airborne. Hands behind the head without pulling the neck.

source_override.muscle_policy: Primary abs with softer source obliques and hip flexors. Both oblique sides are a combined superficial/deep training-emphasis proxy; no claim of measured alternating activation.
required_qa: At the left-knee peak, the right shoulder/elbow must turn forward toward that knee; reverse the pairing at the right-knee peak. Check anatomical sides in world coordinates, not screen direction.
Compare crossed elbow/knee distance and shoulder-forward direction at both peaks. Export parity with a wrong source pose is insufficient.
Check actual fingertip/scalp clearance and seated pelvic support while both feet remain airborne.

source_override.leg_intent: Legs held airborne at approximately90degree hip/knee angles.
source_override.hand_intent: Alternate ipsilateral reaching toward the heel; do not silently change the raised-leg variant into the feet-planted variant.
source_override.muscle_policy: Keep source primary/additional roles. Smooth zones indicate training emphasis, not measured side-specific recruitment.
required_qa: Test both reaching and relaxed fingertips against thigh/hip skin at all phase extremes. A relaxed hand may penetrate the body even when mesh QA reports zero errors.
Aim the reaching fingers toward the lateral heel surface and keep the relaxed hand outside the thigh. Check actual skin clearance, not wrist-bone distance.
Keep the source leg-support mode fixed throughout lateral reaches; measure original-index skin patches and ankle drift in the exported GLB.

source_override.representation: One representative90/90 seated side; mirrored side uses the same motion and mirrored regions.
source_override.source_similarity: The two source descriptions substantially overlap. Preserve their hand-contact cues; do not invent different mechanics merely to distinguish their catalogue IDs.
source_override.muscle_policy: Source labels belong to a stretching exercise. Use cyan stretch zones with stronger source target and softer additional areas; deep hip/lumbar surface masks are illustrative proxies.
source_override.hold_policy: Keep a real20–30second hold in the clip; an optional clearly labeled faster playback is preview-only.
required_qa: Use a coordinated pelvic/spinal hip hinge with a flat back; do not leave the pelvis upright while flexing only the lumbar chain.
Verify the deformed pelvic, thigh/shin and foot support patches together. A good silhouette or low global minimum may hide a pelvic gap of centimeters.
Keep foot contacts fixed through the hinge and preserve the documented or explicitly authored hand-support choice. Correct one contact without sinking another.

render_policy: Only small curated QA still contact sheets; no video, image frame sequence or delivery shadow/AO/specular. QA checker floor is temporary and excluded from GLB.
acceptance: Reports cover exact source/export hashes and sampled phases. Primary owns actual Three.js parity/playback/touch/alpha review; user review remains required.
